shortDescription: French oil major TotalEnergies EURONEXT:TTE said on Monday that it would transfer operatorship of its Papua LNG project in Papua New Guinea to ExxonMobil NYSE:XOM, cut planned capital expenditure to about $14 billion and sell a 9.1% stake to partners while retaining 20%.
